hypotheses.R0_tensor_metric_matches_explicit_operat: The 16-dimensional tensor Gram metric reproduces explicit operator fidelity to error at most 1e-6.
hypotheses.R1_exact_token_beats_matched_identity_nu: Exact current-token routing exceeds the p95 of 64 coarse-class- and frequency-matched identity permutations by at least 0.03 on every corpus.
hypotheses.R2_exact_token_adds_beyond_coarse_class: Exact token identity explains at least 5% of the operator error remaining after the coarse-class router on every corpus.
hypotheses.R3_repeated_tokens_strengthen_identity_r: Among tokens observed at least four times in discovery, exact-token routing exceeds the matched coarse-class router by at least 0.05 fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.R4_token_routing_transfers_across_positi: The mean early-to-late and late-to-early exact-token router reaches at least 0.75 operator fidelity with at least 0.40 coverage on every corpus.
hypotheses.R5_embedding_geometry_routes_unseen_cont: A discovery-frozen ridge map from the native current-token embedding reaches at least 0.75 operator fidelity on every corpus.
hypotheses.R6_position_alone_is_not_the_router: Position-only routing remains at least 0.05 below exact-token routing on every corpus.
hypotheses.R7_coarse_position_does_not_explain_exac: Coarse-class-plus-position routing remains at least 0.03 below exact-token routing on every corpus.
hypotheses.R8_token_position_lookup_is_not_required: Exact-token routing is within 0.05 of the more specific token-plus-position lookup on every corpus.
